throughline.zh: 本週半導體與伺服器供應鏈發布測試設備產能、記憶體通路與資料中心新管制，並有車載模組收購及 SC26 電源、液冷、儲存技術展示。
throughline.en: This week's semiconductor and server supply chains reported test-equipment capacity, memory distribution, data-center controls, an automotive module acquisition and SC26 power, liquid-cooling and storage demonstrations.

title.zh: 先進封裝、晶圓製程設備與資安驗證
title.en: Advanced packaging, wafer equipment and cybersecurity

summary.zh: 精材與台積電先前簽訂先進封裝產能外包協議，日月光路竹廠一期啟用。漢測與 ficonTEC 的測試合作及嘉晶復工已公布；11 月 16 日旺矽再說明探針擴產與 CPO 工程機驗證，台積電於 17 日發布年度供應商名單。
summary.en: Xintec and ASE reported packaging collaboration and construction, while Hermes and Jiajing updated testing and factory operations. WinWay described probe-capacity and CPO qualification plans on November 16, and TSMC named its annual supplier recipients on November 17.

title.zh: 機櫃電源、液冷與伺服器整機展示
title.en: Rack power, liquid cooling and server-system demonstrations

summary.zh: 技嘉、光寶科、貝爾威勒及正文此前公布伺服器、電源、連接器及光模組進度。SC26 新增神雲 96 顆 GPU 液冷機櫃與康舒液冷電源展示，屬產品規格與概念驗證，未代表正式出貨。
summary.en: Gigabyte, Lite-On, Bellwether and Gemtek previously reported server, power, interconnect and optical progress. SC26 brought MiTAC's 96-GPU liquid-cooled rack and AcBel power-cooling exhibits, without production delivery confirmation.

title.zh: 記憶體供應、SSD 控制與工廠營運
title.en: Memory supply, SSD controllers and plant operations

summary.zh: 台灣模組業者先前披露 DRAM 供貨安排，美光台中廠施工事故已明確限於受影響工區。大聯大 11 月 17 日說明記憶體逾半營收比重，慧榮則在 SC26 展示 Gen5、Gen6 企業級 SSD 控制器規格。
summary.en: Taiwan memory-module firms described DRAM allocation, while Micron's Taichung construction suspension covered the affected work area. WPG discussed its memory-heavy sales mix on November 17, and Silicon Motion exhibited Gen5/Gen6 enterprise SSD controllers at SC26.

title.zh: 製程感測、儲能 PCS 與工廠供電
title.en: Process sensors, PCS storage and factory power

summary.zh: 日月光化學感測採購、燿華儲能工程及熙特爾三方 PCS 合作備忘錄屬不同商業狀態。迄今沒有可將這些項目的協議金額、運轉節費及新增儲能容量直接加總的同口徑資料。
summary.en: ASE's sensor order, Unitech's storage project and Xitel's three-party PCS memorandum represent different commercial stages. Their contract values, estimated savings and installed capacity cannot be combined as a single measure.

title.zh: 跨境投資、晶片管制與終端製造
title.en: Cross-border investment, chip controls and end-use manufacturing

summary.zh: 先前已公布經濟部前十月投資核准統計與 GPU 算力池使用成果。美國 BIS 11 月 16 日公布新高階晶片輸出及遠端算力規範，11 月 17 日鴻海簽約擬收購 Sony 車用相機模組業務，兩案的生效與交割狀態均待後續文件確認。
summary.en: MOEA had reported approved investment and NSTC compute-pool usage. BIS published new advanced-chip and remote-compute controls on November 16, and Foxconn agreed to buy Sony's automotive camera-module business on November 17; commencement and deal closing require later confirmation.
